x: Gregory could not be there as he would have made the race more interesting for the first three places. A. Burns, one of our new men from Eastleigh, was most unfortunate to be disqualified in the first 50 yards.
The winner Noji (Poland) set up a new British record of 29 mins. 43.4 secs., whilst runner-up A. Burns, Elswick Harriers, set new figures for the native British record.
